title: AI-quantified PSMA PET-CT tumour volume is associated with survival in prostate cancer
summary: A previously developed fully automated AI model quantified total lesion volume on PSMA PET-CT in 267 patients followed for 5 years, of whom 48 (18%) died. Whole-body total lesion volume was significantly associated with mortality (p=0.001; primary staging p=0.014), whereas the biochemical recurrence subgroup was not significant (p=0.061). Single-center retrospective study with age-adjusted Cox models; the AI model was not developed here.
ai_technology: Previously developed fully automated AI model quantifying tumour volume on PSMA PET-CT

evidence.tested: Association of AI-measured tumour volume with 5-year mortality in 267 patients.
evidence.unknown: External validation, adjustment for other prognostic factors and clinical benefit are not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: An existing AI model measured tumour volume without manual correction.
